rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for simply urinating.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gap1 zyu6 jiu3 o1 niu6

rows.note: Use this when someone urinates in their own clothes or wets their pants.

example.english: The little boy sometimes has to pee in his pants at night.
example.traditional: 個細路仔有時夜晚會尿褲。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 zai2 jau5 si4 je6 maan5 wui5 niu6 fu3

rows.note: Use this construction when the place or object being urinated in or on needs to be specified.

example.english: The dog likes to pee on the sofa at home.
example.traditional: 隻狗鍾意喺屋企張梳化度屙尿。
example.jyutping: zek3 gau2 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei2 zoeng1 so1 faa2 dou6 o1 niu6
